review.summary: Ujjwal confirmed his identity, said his salary was late, and promised to pay the full ₹4700 tomorrow (14 Oct 2026). Meera ignored this and asked for his full name again, twice. She never acknowledged the reason, confirmed the promise, or closed the call with a next step.
